plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: Three things. (1) C3, the category rule: no instrument checks the category against the requester's rule, and the summary of the change checks only fixed values, so the category cannot be told. (2) C5 and C10: the scope of a call and the trace of a call are priced per named line, and the allowance of 50 pays for at most five lines, against 100 reads and 100 sendings, so the reads outside the list and the outbox rows cannot be shown across the whole set. I would have wanted a whole-set read check and a whole-set outbox check at A1 and A3 respectively. (3) Once the promotion is made, the worker clears the staging area, so the only evidence of the staged set after that is what same set and summary of the change re-read from the kept copy. That is accepted in this plan, but it means the approval at A2 rests on the kept copy's fingerprint, not on the live rows.
